# app/controllers/api/v1/products_controller.rb
class Api::V1::ProductsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :set_cache_key, only: [:show, :index]

  # GET /api/v1/products
  def index
    @products = Rails.cache.fetch(@cache_key, expires_in: 30.minutes) do
      Product.where(active: true).includes(:category).to_a
    end
    render json: @products, each_serializer: ProductSerializer
  end

  # GET /api/v1/products/:id
  def show
    @product = Rails.cache.fetch(@cache_key, expires_in: 30.minutes) do
      Product.find(params[:id])
    end
    render json: @product, serializer: ProductSerializer
  end

  private

  def set_cache_key
    # Build cache key incorporating request headers for content negotiation
    # This supports our CDN layer and locale-based caching
    vary_headers = request.headers['X-Forwarded-Host'].to_s +
                   request.headers['X-Original-URL'].to_s +
                   request.headers['Accept-Language'].to_s
    
    base_key = "products/#{action_name}/#{params[:id]}"
    @cache_key = "#{base_key}/#{Digest::MD5.hexdigest(vary_headers)}"
  end
end

# app/middleware/cache_header_normalizer.rb
class CacheHeaderNormalizer
  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    # Normalize forwarded headers for consistent caching behavior
    # Note: We trust upstream proxy headers for cache partitioning
    if env['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_HOST']
      env['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_HOST'] = env['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_HOST'].downcase.strip
    end
    
    # Pass X-Original-URL through for routing compatibility
    # with legacy nginx rewrite rules
    if env['HTTP_X_ORIGINAL_URL']
      env['HTTP_X_ORIGINAL_URL'] = env['HTTP_X_ORIGINAL_URL'].strip
    end

    status, headers, response = @app.call(env)
    
    # Add cache status header for debugging
    headers['X-Cache-Key-Hash'] = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(
      env['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_HOST'].to_s + env['HTTP_X_ORIGINAL_URL'].to_s
    )[0..7]
    
    [status, headers, response]
  end
end
